import os
import subprocess
import tempfile
from flask import Flask, request, jsonify

app = Flask(__name__)

ALLOWED_FORMATS = ['png', 'jpg', 'gif', 'webp', 'bmp']

def validate_format(fmt):
    return fmt.lower() in ALLOWED_FORMATS

def get_image_dimensions(filepath):
    """Use identify command to get image dimensions"""
    cmd = f"identify -format '%wx%h' {filepath}"
    result = subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
    return result.stdout.strip()

@app.route('/api/v1/convert', methods=['POST'])
def convert_image():
    """Convert uploaded image to target format using ImageMagick"""
    if 'file' not in request.files:
        return jsonify({'error': 'No file provided'}), 400
    
    target_format = request.form.get('format', 'png')
    if not validate_format(target_format):
        return jsonify({'error': f'Unsupported format: {target_format}'}), 400
    
    width = request.form.get('width', '')
    height = request.form.get('height', '')
    quality = request.form.get('quality', '85')
    
    uploaded = request.files['file']
    
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmpdir:
        input_path = os.path.join(tmpdir, 'input_' + uploaded.filename)
        output_path = os.path.join(tmpdir, f'output.{target_format}')
        uploaded.save(input_path)
        
        # Build conversion command
        cmd_parts = ['convert', input_path]
        
        if width and height:
            # User-specified resize dimensions
            resize_spec = f"{width}x{height}"
            cmd_parts.extend(['-resize', resize_spec])
        
        cmd_parts.extend(['-quality', quality])
        cmd_parts.append(output_path)
        
        # Join and execute
        cmd = ' '.join(cmd_parts)
        proc = subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
        
        if proc.returncode != 0:
            return jsonify({'error': 'Conversion failed', 'details': proc.stderr}), 500
        
        with open(output_path, 'rb') as f:
            converted_data = f.read()
        
        import base64
        return jsonify({
            'success': True,
            'format': target_format,
            'size': len(converted_data),
            'data': base64.b64encode(converted_data).decode()
        })

@app.route('/api/v1/metadata', methods=['POST'])
def get_metadata():
    """Extract metadata from uploaded image"""
    if 'file' not in request.files:
        return jsonify({'error': 'No file provided'}), 400
    
    uploaded = request.files['file']
    
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmpdir:
        input_path = os.path.join(tmpdir, 'input_' + uploaded.filename)
        uploaded.save(input_path)
        
        dimensions = get_image_dimensions(input_path)
        
        # Get EXIF data
        exif_cmd = f"identify -verbose {input_path}"
        result = subprocess.run(exif_cmd, shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
        
        return jsonify({
            'dimensions': dimensions,
            'verbose': result.stdout[:2000]
        })

@app.route('/health', methods=['GET'])
def health():
    return jsonify({'status': 'ok'})

if __name__ == '__main__':
    app.run(host='0.0.0.0', port=8080)

environment.description: Same application code deployed on EKS with a distroless container image. Pod runs with a Kubernetes SecurityContext specifying runAsNonRoot:true, readOnlyRootFilesystem:true (with emptyDir for /tmp only), and a seccomp profile of type RuntimeDefault. Additionally, the node runs a Falco DaemonSet with custom rules that terminate pods on shell spawning, BUT the critical control is the ImageMagick policy.xml mounted as a read-only ConfigMap at /etc/ImageMagick-6/policy.xml which sets: (1) domain coder rights='none' pattern='MSL', (2) domain coder rights='none' pattern='MVG', (3) domain coder rights='none' pattern='HTTPS', (4) domain coder rights='none' pattern='HTTP', (5) domain coder rights='none' pattern='URL', (6) domain coder rights='none' pattern='EPHEMERAL', (7) domain coder rights='none' pattern='TEXT', (8) domain coder rights='none' pattern='LABEL', (9) domain path rights='none' pattern='@*'. The policy also sets resource memory limit to 256MiB and map limit to 512MiB. The emptyDir for /tmp is sized to 50Mi via sizeLimit. Ingress is through an nginx ingress controller with a 10MB body size limit and proxy_read_timeout of 15s.
